requiredFindings.summary: The alive-root control still lacks the lifecycle proof and cleanup claimed by the frozen package.
requiredFindings.details: The injected group-kill-failure case obtains the root pid and proves it was not a by-pid request, but it never asserts ExitClass::Unreaped, never asserts absence of ExitObserved, never proves the root is alive at settlement, and never kills that root. Its cleanup loop covers only descendant pids from the fixture file; the root is left to the fixture's 60-second self-exit. Add the missing alive-root assertions, distinguish its confirm evidence from the held-zombie RootAlone case, kill the surviving root out of band, verify it is gone, and refresh the final component evidence and summary.

nonBlockingObservations.summary: Manifest, members, Git bases, authorities, all fifteen product rows, archived candidate bytes, and final pins match exactly.
The root-inclusive snapshot and provider/tool boundary corrections are present, and all eight mutations are caught by runtime tests rather than compilation failures.

The final source and evidence otherwise implement bounded macOS descendant handling, original-error retention, confirm latching, per-pid fact accounting, reap-last ordering, and the conservative no-cgroup guard.
The equal baseline/candidate owner-label expectation failure is disclosed without a whole-check claim; D3b-2, D3b-L, codec reruns, production wiring, and qualification remain open.
